author: David Wilson
title: Trump Threatens National Emergency Over ICE Defiance - NewsBreak
text:
By David Wilson ,
18 minutes ago President Donald Trump has threatened to assume control of the Washington, D.C., Metropolitan Police following Mayor Muriel Bowser’s refusal to cooperate with Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE). He argued that such noncompliance could lead to increases in violent crime and pledged to federalize the police if necessary. Bowser said police will cooperate with ICE only in specific legal cases.
Trump stated, “Under pressure from the Radical Left Democrats, Mayor Muriel Bowser, who has presided over this violent criminal takeover of our Capital for years, has informed the Federal Government that the Metropolitan Police Department will no longer cooperate with ICE in removing and relocating dangerous illegal aliens.”
Trump previously invoked the Home Rule Act to federalize the D.C. police and deployed 2,000 National Guard troops. Federal law enforcement data showed a 25% drop in property crime and a 10% reduction in violent crime early in the surge.
Trump wrote, “The Federal Government, under my auspices as President of the United States of America, has stepped into the complete criminal mess that was Washington, D.C., our Nation’s Capital.”
Trump added, “Because of this, D.C. has gone from one of the most dangerous and murder ridden cities in the U.S.A., and even around the World, to one of the safest – In just a few weeks. The ‘place’ is absolutely booming, with restaurants, stores, and businesses packed and, for the first time in decades, virtually NO CRIME. It has been a beautiful thing to watch.”
Immigrant advocates have warned that heightened ICE presence could intimidate communities and reduce crime reporting.
Bowser said, “Immigration enforcement is not what the MPD does. And with the end of the emergency, it won’t be what MPD does in the future.”
David Wilson covers U.S. politics & news for content partner Modern Newsstand LLC.
